protocol.title: L3 slot AdamW-state causal decomposition

training.rule: reset only the registered L3 slot AdamW moments at opening; preserve all other state and RNG

protocol.primary_test: whether clearing L3 slot AdamW first/second moments removes the non-monotonic interference
protocol.stop_rule: no weight-decay changes, extra optimizer modes, doses, delays, seeds, or steps

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
